fields.name: S2_API_KEY
fields.label: Semantic Scholar API Key
fields.description: Get one at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api — without it, requests are heavily rate-limited.

fields.name: OPENALEX_MAILTO
fields.label: OpenAlex polite-pool email
fields.description: Your email — joins OpenAlex's polite pool for faster + more stable responses.

fields.name: MAX_CORPUS_SIZE
fields.label: Max papers per survey
fields.description: Cap how many papers the talent fetches before forced to summarize. Higher = more thorough but slower/more expensive.

fields.name: STRICT_CITATION_VERIFICATION
fields.label: Block on hallucinated citations
fields.description: If on, output is rejected when verify_citations finds any unverified citation. If off, unverified cites are flagged but not blocked.
